crossRefs.note: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

people.name: Adoni-bezek
people.line: Canaanite king captured and mutilated by Judah

translations.web: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
translations.bsb: As Adoni-bezek fled, they pursued him, seized him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
translations.kjv: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
translations.asv: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
